notes:
Bug fixes. No changes to how scaling works.

Fixed

  • The Scaled Scene button in the Scenes sidebar is back to normal size. It was being placed below the search bar and stretched to fill the whole header. It now sits in the action row next to Create Scene and Create Folder, and looks like Foundry's own buttons.
  • Log lines no longer print twice in the browser console.

Requirements

  • Foundry VTT v13, dnd5e 5.x (verified against 5.2.5).
  • Scorpious187's Module Library is installed automatically as a dependency.
  • libWrapper is recommended: attack range, melee reach, movement, and vision scaling need it. Spell and area scaling works without it.
